provenance.data: OiDB 696baf06: 12 *_SINGLE_SCI_VIS_CALIBRATED*.fits of the data PI (Klement), HIGH resolution, 1628 channels, public L3. Downloaded 2026-10-21 (hashes as oidb/manifest.yml) into ~/data/eso_binaries/trackb/hr6819/oifits/.
provenance.calibration: The PI's calibration (not redone: the calibrators are not in these files). scripts/gravity_bin_calibrated.py bins the science channels by 8 and averages the two polarisations of the 2021 files; virgil-vlti's gravity_single_high_combined_2023-2025 template is laid out on the files (to_oidata template=) for V² gains and closure offsets. The two 2021 nights are SPLIT polarisation and the combined template refuses them, so they are left out.
